* **Bacteria reproduce independently:** They can divide and multiply rapidly on their own, allowing antibiotics to kill them before they cause too much damage.
* **Viruses hijack host cells:** Viruses must invade a living host cell and use that cell's machinery (ribosomes, enzymes) to force it to produce thousands of copies of the virus. Antibiotics have no mechanism to interfere with this hijacking process.
